title: Album Open
description: Twelve Beatles albums in a library grid. Open one and its cover lifts out of the grid and lands as the album header, tinted by the record's own colour, while the title and tracklist rise in after it; Back or Escape sends the same cover home to its slot.
intent: One cover that is never replaced: a single flying copy carries it between grid and header on a spring, above everything, and every flight can be caught and reversed mid-air.
